hallucinationResult.description: Output only. The result of the hallucination check. There will be one hallucination result for each turn in the conversation.

taskCompleted.description: Output only. Whether the task was completed for this turn. This is a composite of all expectations satisfied, no hallucinations, and user goal satisfaction.

allExpectationsSatisfied.description: Output only. Whether all expectations were satisfied for this turn.

taskCompletionResult.description: Output only. The result of the task completion check.

EvaluationResultScenarioResult.description: The outcome of a scenario evaluation.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as ListEvaluationsRequest.page_token to retrieve the next page. Absence of this field indicates there are no subsequent pages.
